purpose: Teach: 序文/ステートメント/コーティング/受領/取締り/移管/とりまとめ/仲間入り

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文の序文に研究背景を明示しろ
lines.en: Ren — make sure the research background is explicit in your paper's introduction.
lines.style: Measured, direct instruction. Even delivery. Brief pause after name to signal this matters. No lecturing tone — expecting competence, showing the way forward.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。指導教授の公式ステートメントを参考にします
lines.en: Yes. I'll use my advisor's official statement as a reference.
lines.style: Respectful but assured. Steady pace. Slight formality in the 'I will' — showing deference without hesitation. Clean acknowledgment of the direction given.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、実験試料のコーティング条件を確認しろ
lines.en: Ren — verify the coating conditions for your experimental samples.
lines.style: Same measured tone as before. Slightly firmer on the verb — this is concrete and must be checked. No room for interpretation, but delivered as a professional task.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費の受領証を提出いたしました
lines.en: Yes. I've already submitted the funding receipts.
lines.style: Quiet confidence underneath. He's ahead of the question — already done. Not defensive, just showing he's tracking things carefully. Slight relief in the closure.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究室の不正取締りを厳格にしろ
lines.en: Ren — tighten oversight on research integrity in the lab.
lines.style: Heavier weight on this one. Calm but serious. Slightly slower pace — this is more than a technical task, it carries responsibility. Direct eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。プロジェクトの新担当者への移管を進めます
lines.en: Yes. I'm working on transitioning that responsibility to the new project manager.
lines.style: Steady, measured response. He understands the weight but isn't overwhelmed. Shows he's already thinking in steps. Slight formality in 'transitioning' — he's taking this seriously.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究データのとりまとめを急げ
lines.en: Ren — accelerate your data compilation. We need it soon.
lines.style: A shift in urgency. Slightly faster delivery. The second sentence underlines it. Still controlled, still professional, but the pressure is now audible in the tempo.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会への仲間入りを果たすべく頑張ります
lines.en: Yes. I'll work hard to make my way into the conference.
lines.style: Earnest momentum building. Slight warmth enters his voice now — this is personal, not just task-following. Small lift at the end. Conviction wrapped in humility.
